title: QA Wolf makes the interface travel with the coding agent
friendlyTitle: QA Wolf brings useful screens into the coding assistant
summary: QA Wolf explains how it redesigned test creation and review so its MCP integration can present focused interfaces inside a coding agent’s browser pane. Applying the same constraints to its main product also helped the company remove steps and simplify the wider workflow.
friendlySummary: Developers can create and review software tests without leaving the AI coding tool they already use.
whyItMatters: Agent-first design does not have to mean replacing every screen with chat. A better pattern is to let the agent bring a small, task-specific interface to the user at the point where a decision or review is needed.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Good AI products can show a simple screen when people need to check or choose something instead of forcing every task into chat.
